title_voiceover: This lecture covers white blood cell neoplasms. We'll start with general diagnostic approaches including cell surface markers, cytogenetics, and prognostic factors. Then we'll explore B cell neoplasms including Hodgkin lymphoma, diffuse large B cell lymphoma, and chronic lymphocytic leukemia. We'll also cover T cell neoplasms, plasma cell dyscrasias, and miscellaneous conditions.
